node.statement: Under the hypotheses of node 1, lem-maincb-structural-domain-ledger applies to this same fixed W and yields epsilon <= W.e1/W.K1 and t_1:=W.K1*epsilon <= W.r_reset. Since 0 <= epsilon and W.K1 >= K_1^0 >= 1, also 0 <= epsilon <= t_1; hence the ambient defect epsilon of the target A is at most the raw-call scale t_1.
